description: This file defines API route handlers for managing notes in a note-organizing application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, updating, and deleting notes, utilizing FastAPI framework features such as path operations, dependencies, and response models. The logic involves interactions with a database through fetch functions, handling user-specific notes, and ensuring folder ownership validation.

methods.name: list[NoteResponse] list_notes( folder_id: UUID | None = Query(None, description="Filter notes by folder id."), current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list notes for the current user, optionally filtered by folder_id.

methods.name: NoteResponse create_note(payload: NoteCreateRequest, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note for the current user.

methods.name: NoteResponse update_note( note_id: UUID, payload: NoteUpdateRequest, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update an existing note owned by the current user.

methods.name: None delete_note(note_id: UUID, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note owned by the current user.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def create_note(payload: NoteCreateRequest, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)) -> N/

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_note(note_id: UUID, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)) -> None:$/

ctags.name: list_notes
ctags.signature: ( folder_id: UUID | None = Query(None, description="Filter notes by folder id."), current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: UUID, payload: NoteUpdateRequest, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user), )
